title: Chemtrails Are Eliminating Millions Of Birds
text: There is a lot of land people do not see or walk on. There are a lot of woods, forests, mountains, hills, valleys that people are not allowed on. government land, classified land, land for testing, land for mining, or just endless swaths of land, vast amount of acres that nobody has access to. And even private land nobody has access to, but the birds do. They have access to this land. And the majority of the birds fly and die over this land, die from chemtrails and land on the land dead or dying. And no one sees it. Millions and millions of birds over the years have fallen into these federal lands, into these private lands, into these forests, these hills, these valleys, on these mountains, and the death is not seen. These birds are not seen. [Music]
